# SEDS Pakistan

> SEDS Pakistan (Students for the Exploration and Development of Space - Pakistan) is a student-led aerospace engineering society based at the Institute of Space Technology (IST), Islamabad, Pakistan. Its members build rockets, CubeSats and planetary rovers, and run space science education and outreach across Pakistan.

SEDS Pakistan is an independent student-led aerospace engineering initiative. Its registration under the Societies Registration Act 1860 (Act XXI of 1860) is currently in process.

## Current programme

- South Asia Aerospace Grand Prix: a paid masterclass series run with SEDS Sri Lanka, held on weekends from 6 to 20 December 2026. Registration is open until 15 November 2026, 23:59 PKT. External students pay USD 7; SEDS members attend free. Details: https://sedspakistan.live/grand-prix — Register: https://sedspakistan.live/grand-prix/register

## Engineering disciplines

- Rocketry: propulsion, airframes, recovery and range safety
- CubeSats: satellite systems, communications and ground stations
- Rovers: planetary robotics and autonomous systems
